text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return up to 10 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.

text_sections.label: Security Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
